rooms.title: DPDP Overview and Scope
learning_objectives: Explain dpdp overview and scope using the cited provisions.
Apply the requirement to a guided scenario.
Complete six cited challenge tasks.

walkthrough.title: Read the legal anchor
walkthrough.body: Start with Sections 1-3. Identify the exact obligation, permission, right, restriction or procedure described by the official source.

walkthrough.title: Translate law into facts
walkthrough.body: Apply map the processing activity to applicable scope, defined roles, purpose, source, rights and evidence under the cited provision. Record the data, purpose, actors, system, decision owner and evidence relevant to this room.

walkthrough.title: Test the control
walkthrough.body: Use the six interactive tasks to challenge the proposed workflow. Explain every answer from the cited provision, not a generic privacy assumption.

walkthrough.title: Create evidence
walkthrough.body: Record the decision, cited provision, owner, date, unresolved questions and remediation so the exercise becomes an auditable control pattern.

rooms.summary: DPDP Overview and Scope is a practical DPDP learning room focused on DPDP fundamentals. The learner works from Sections 1-3, applies it to a fictional Indian organisation, identifies evidence and tests a concrete control decision.

case_study.title: BharatLearn case study: DPDP Overview and Scope
case_study.scenario: A fictional organisation, BharatLearn 1, is reviewing a processing activity covered by Sections 1-3. The privacy team has incomplete documentation and wants to proceed immediately. You are the reviewer. Determine what the team must establish, what evidence should be retained, and which step should happen before the processing decision.
facts: Processing topic: DPDP Overview and Scope.
Operational context: the organisation wants a repeatable control that can be evidenced during an internal review.
investigation_steps: Identify the processing activity, actors, data categories and purpose.
Read and cite Sections 1-3 from the official source.
Separate confirmed facts from assumptions and record missing evidence.
Choose the control response and document the owner, deadline and evidence.
case_study.expected_outcome: A traceable decision that states the applicable legal reference, operational facts, control response and evidence required.

cheat_sheet: Legal anchor: Sections 1-3
Evidence: purpose, data category, actors, processing flow, decision owner and date.
Escalate: unresolved statutory interpretation, conflicting facts or missing evidence.
Source discipline: prefer the official Act/Rules text over secondary summaries.

penalty_context.relevance: Potential enforcement relevance depends on the actual contravention and statutory assessment.
penalty_context.guidance: Do not invent or hard-code a penalty from a scenario. Identify the contravention first, then consult Section 33 and the Schedule where applicable, together with the current notified framework.

final_challenge.scenario: You are the privacy reviewer for BharatLearn. Produce a one-page control decision for DPDP Overview and Scope: state the applicable reference (Sections 1-3), confirmed facts, unresolved facts, required control, evidence owner and escalation point.
final_challenge.flag: A defensible answer must distinguish statutory text from assumptions and preserve an evidence trail.

tasks.title: Interactive room assessment
tasks.description: Six source-linked tasks for DPDP Overview and Scope. Use hints before submitting if unsure.

questions.prompt: What is the central compliance task for DPDP Overview and Scope?
options: map the processing activity to applicable scope, defined roles, purpose, source, rights and evidence under the cited provision
Skip the legal reference and rely only on a vendor statement.
Collect every possible data field first and decide the purpose later.
Treat the room topic as automatically exempt from the DPDP framework.
questions.explanation: Map concrete processing facts to the cited statutory requirement and retain evidence.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.

questions.prompt: In the BharatLearn case for DPDP Overview and Scope, what should the reviewer do first?
options: Map the processing facts and decision to Sections 1-3, then identify the evidence required by the applicable provision.
Approve the processing because the organisation has a privacy policy.
Delete all records immediately without checking purpose or retention requirements.
Assume a third-party contract transfers all statutory responsibility.
questions.explanation: A defensible workflow starts with facts, the applicable provision and evidence.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.

questions.prompt: Which proposed action is the clearest control failure for DPDP Overview and Scope?
options: Proceeding without checking the cited statutory requirement.
Recording the purpose, data category, owner and supporting evidence.
Escalating an unresolved legal question to the privacy/compliance owner.
Keeping an auditable decision record linked to the applicable provision.
questions.explanation: The first option bypasses the legal requirement instead of establishing a traceable decision.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.

questions.prompt: True or false: a generic privacy policy by itself proves that the specific DPDP Overview and Scope requirement has been satisfied.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: A policy is not, by itself, evidence that a particular processing activity satisfies every applicable statutory requirement.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.

questions.prompt: Flag the strongest primary compliance record for DPDP Overview and Scope.
options: A dated control record linking the activity to Sections 1-3, owner, decision and supporting evidence.
An undated social-media post about privacy.
A marketing claim that the company is privacy friendly.
A screenshot with no processing context or source.
questions.explanation: A traceable record linked to the applicable provision is stronger evidence than generic commentary.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.

questions.prompt: What should happen if the facts do not fit Sections 1-3 cleanly?
options: Pause the unsupported conclusion, document the uncertainty and obtain the appropriate legal/compliance review.
Choose the most convenient interpretation and continue processing.
Delete the evidence so the issue cannot be raised later.
Assume the strictest possible rule without checking the official text.
questions.explanation: Uncertainty should be documented and escalated rather than hidden or resolved by unsupported assumptions.

hints.text: Read Sections 1-3 in the official source before choosing.
Identify the processing facts, then compare each option with the cited requirement.
